nodes.content: Independent Exp(1) random variables E_n, n>=1.
Named strong law of large numbers, without theorem citation or expanded hypotheses.
Almost-sure divergence of the exponential partial sums, appearing in the source as the positive fixed-scale sum tending to infinity.
Integrability and expectation one of Exp(1) are not expanded in the paper.
Exact SLLN statement and its iid/integrability instantiation are omitted background.
The normalized strong-law limit and scalar implication to divergence are not spelled out by the author.
Strict positivity almost everywhere, zero-null event, and simultaneous countable-index positivity are unstated law consequences.
The paper does not construct a countable product probability space; a selected concrete actual-input model must construct its probability, marginals, measurability and independence internally.
The paper prescribes no clamp. If selected, its measurable total semantics and a.e. equality to the coordinate require audit; strict positivity is still only a.e.
